content: Ollama OpenAI-compatible layer default base URL http://localhost:11434/v1/. Endpoints: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/completions, /v1/models, /v1/models/{model}, /v1/embeddings, /v1/responses. API key required-but-ignored (any string works, e.g. 'ollama'; no real auth). Unsupported OpenAI request fields on /v1/chat/completions: tool_choice, logit_bias, user, n, logprobs. Native (non-compatible) API is /api/chat, /api/generate, /api/tags (model list), /api/pull etc., using NDJSON streaming by default; the OpenAI-compatible /v1 layer uses standard SSE 'data: ' framing matching OpenAI.
